master.definition_en: A rare subtype of congenital pulmonary airway malformation characterized by a multicystic mass of non-functioning lung tissue with one or more dominant cysts of 2 to 10 cm in diameter, which may be surrounded by smaller cysts. The lesions have intracystic communications, can be connected to the tracheobronchial tree, and are usually unilateral, involving a single lobe. Small lesions may remain asymptomatic, while most cases present with respiratory distress in the neonatal period or in infancy, or with recurrent respiratory infections later in life. Pulmonary hypoplasia and severe fetal hydrops are rare complications. The condition is associated with an increased risk of pulmonary malignancy, such as bronchoalveolar carcinoma.

master.definition_en: A sleep disorder characterized by a tendency for excessive sleepiness during the day which occurs even after adequate sleep in the nighttime. The persons who suffer from this condition experience fatigue and may fall asleep at inappropriate times during the day.

mechanisms: Sodium channel protein type V alpha subunit blocker

curated.category: 神经系统与罕见睡眠障碍
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 疾病本身不直接破坏生命器官，但白天不可抗拒的突发性睡眠及大笑/情绪激动诱发的“猝倒”（肌张力突然丧失倒地）极易在驾驶、高空作业、过马路或游泳时引发致命意外。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前1型发作性睡病由于下丘脑食欲素（Orexin）神经元不可逆丢失尚难根治，但通过H3受体反向激动剂替洛利生、莫达非尼/文拉法辛等控制日间嗜睡与猝倒，以及中国新获批的首款食欲素受体激动剂Oveporexton，绝大多数患者可恢复正常学业与职业生活。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Orphanet未单列直接死亡率，主要风险为猝倒及突发性睡眠导致的交通事故等意外伤害

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球1型发作性睡病患病率约20–50/10万（1/2,000–1/5,000，Orphanet ORPHA:619284）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国人群患病率约0.034%（约34/10万，全国患者估计超40万例），多在10–20岁青少年期起病，常被误诊为“懒惰”或抑郁

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 口服食欲素2型受体激动剂Oveporexton（TAK-861）在3期FirstLight与RadiantLight研究中显著恢复患者客观清醒度并近乎消除猝倒，已获中国NMPA批准成为全球首批直接靶向食欲素通路的革新疗法；2) 多款二代OX2R激动剂（如ALKS 2680等）正开展2/3期试验，力争进一步降低尿频/失眠等副作用。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 中国患者从发病到确诊平均延误长达8–10年，基层多导睡眠监测（PSG）及多次睡眠潜伏期试验（MSLT）可及性低；2) 食欲素神经元在起病时已被自身免疫破坏，尚无再生或早期免疫阻断方案；3) 青少年学龄期校园合理便利制度仍待完善。

master.definition_en: A rare obstetric condition characterized by entry of amniotic fluid and fetal elements into the maternal circulation, causing an emergency situation with sudden cardiovascular collapse, disseminated intravascular coagulation, and high lethality. In most instances it occurs during labor, cesarean delivery, or within 30 minutes postpartum. Patients present acute dyspnea and cough, acute hypotension, encephalopathy with altered mental status and seizures, hypoxia and cyanosis, coagulopathy, severe hemorrhage, uterine atony, acute pulmonary hypertension, and cardiac arrest.
